name: How long does it take to see results from an AI-optimized AEO strategy?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from an AI-optimized AEO strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from an AI-optimized AEO strategy can vary. Initial improvements in visibility, especially for specific answer boxes and featured snippets, may begin to appear within 3-6 months. However, significant and sustained impact, including broader authority building and consistent presence in diverse answer engine results, often takes 6-12 months or more. Factors influencing this timeline include the competitiveness of your industry, the initial state of your website's content, and the ongoing adaptation to algorithm changes. AEO is a continuous effort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial results may appear in 3-6 months, with significant impact taking 6-12 months or more, depending on industry and website condition.
